payload.title: The legacy farm NATS subjects getWaterQualityOverview, getFeedingOverview, getHarvestOverview, getBatchOverview, getTankRegistry and createTask declare their payloads separately in each responder and caller outside libs/event-contracts, and the readers answer [] for malformed or failed requests
evidence: apps/farm-service/src/water-quality/responders/get-water-quality-overview.responder.ts:18 (request interface declared inside the farm responder, not in libs/event-contracts; same pattern in the feeding :18, harvest :15, batch :16 and tank-registry :22 responders)
apps/farm-service/src/water-quality/responders/get-water-quality-overview.responder.ts:44 (a malformed request answers [] and a failure answers [] at :83, indistinguishable from no data)
apps/ai-service/src/tools/farm/get-farm-water-quality.tool.ts:14 (ai-service re-declares WaterQualityReading and sends the string-literal subject at :63)
apps/ai-service/src/tools/farm/create-task.tool.ts:25 (a second hand-written copy of CreateTaskNatsResponse; the request shape lives in create-task.responder.ts:17)
apps/messaging-service/src/ai/services/knowledge-extraction.service.ts:422 (a third service calls request.farm.getTankRegistry by string literal)
libs/event-contracts/src/farm-ai-queries.ts:13 (the contract itself records that the overview responders' [] cannot be told from no data)
payload.rule_violated: Repo rule of one owner per contract with hierarchy impossible > automatic > detectable: NATS request and reply shapes are owned by libs/event-contracts, and a cross-service subject declared twice can drift silently.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-09, release R5.
